title: QUIC RFC 9000 Connection Close Packet-Level Emission Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests for S10P2P3 close packet-level emission, adjacent close/packet-space regression tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers locally generated CONNECTION_CLOSE packet selection and lower-protection downgrade behavior before and after handshake confirmation.
expected_result: A confirmed connection emits application close in a protected 1-RTT packet. Before confirmation, a server with Initial, Handshake, and 1-RTT protect material emits one close packet in each packet number space. Initial and Handshake closes carry transport APPLICATION_ERROR with no reason phrase when the original close request was application-specific.
procedure: Run the focused S10P2P3 requirement-home filter.
Run adjacent close-frame and packet-space regression filters.
preconditions: The runtime has an active path with enough anti-amplification budget for the emitted close datagrams.
The test runtime seeds Initial, Handshake, and 1-RTT protect material without marking the QUIC handshake confirmed.
Post-confirmation proof uses an existing finished server runtime with 1-RTT protect material.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim packet coalescing, CONNECTION_CLOSE retransmission, or peer close-frame parsing changes.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The Release build passed with zero warnings, the focused S10P2P3 no-build filter passed 8/8, the adjacent close/packet-space no-build filter passed 19/19, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marked the ten targeted S10P2P3 requirements trace_clean, and SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 352 artifacts.
